The venue itself is beautiful, especially with its open layout and seaside vibe, which added a whole different energy to the event. Everything was extremely well-organized—from entry management to crowd control—making the experience smooth despite the massive turnout.

The highlight, of course, was the music. DJs like DJ Chetas, AERRO, and Maddock absolutely killed it with their sets. The crowd energy was insane, and every drop just elevated the vibe even more. It felt like a perfect mix of music, colors, and pure celebration.

The overall setup—colors, water arrangements, security, and facilities—was well handled, ensuring both fun and safety. The atmosphere was lively, vibrant, and full of positive energy throughout.

If you’re looking for a high-energy, well-managed Holi event in Mumbai, Holi at the Bay at Bayview Lawns is definitely something you shouldn’t miss.
